scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,CRM,WEB -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend-admin" "npm run dev -w frontend-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend-admin && npm run build -w frontend-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend-admin && npm run typecheck -w frontend-web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src/v2 backend/src/config backend/src/app.js backend/src/server.js backend/scripts backend/tests frontend-admin/src frontend-web/app frontend-web/components frontend-web/lib scripts
